question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a complete **left-front brake replacement** on your Voltrieve Fjord AWD, the service guide specifies the following parts. The AWD uses a 370 mm front disc.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake disc, 370 mm | **VP-10072** |
| 1 | Front brake pad set | **VP-10254** |
| 1 | Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10345** |
| 1 | Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10527** |

 (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | **VP-10631** |
| 1 | Front-left pad wear sensor | **VP-10670** |
| 1 | Front caliper fitting kit | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10761** |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1 litre | **VP-15168** |

 (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

The pad set covers **both sides of the front axle**; the service guide says to renew pads as an axle set even when working on one side. The fluid is for bleeding the circuit afterwards.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md) (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

question: brakes-fjord

For a complete **front-left brake replacement** on your Fjord AWD, you need the following. The AWD front disc is 370 mm. (Source: *voltrieve-service-guide.md*)

| Qty | Part | Article number |

| 1 | Front-left brake disc, 370 mm | **VP-10072** |
